name: physics_quantities
description: Identify physical quantities from their standard SI units, without calculations or conversion.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
facts=[('newton','force'),('joule','energy'),('watt','power'),('pascal','pressure'),('hertz','frequency'),('coulomb','charge'),('volt','voltage'),('ohm','resistance'),('farad','capacitance'),('henry','inductance'),('tesla','magnetic flux density'),('weber','magnetic flux'),('kilogram','mass'),('metre','length'),('second','time'),('kelvin','temperature'),('ampere','electric current'),('mole','amount of substance'),('candela','luminous intensity'),('siemens','conductance')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(4):
 for unit,quantity in facts:
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white']);stem=f'SI unit: {unit}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['What physical quantity is measured in this unit? Quantity:','Name the corresponding physical quantity. Quantity:','This unit measures which physical quantity? Quantity:','Give the physical quantity associated with this unit. Quantity:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+quantity});control.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the marker? Marker:','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
